context.problemStatement: Show four eighths as half of a whole.
context.solutionStrategy: Use the quantities given in the problem.
context.groundingProse: Divide one bar into eight equal pieces, shade four pieces. Four eighths equals one half.

content.altText: A fraction bar divided into eight equal parts with four parts shaded, representing four eighths.

annotations.steps: I divide the fraction bar into eight equal parts and shade four of those parts to show four eighths.
annotations.strategy: I notice that shading half of the total parts visually proves that four eighths is the exact same amount as one half.
annotations.misconceptions: A common mistake is thinking that because the denominator is eight, the fraction must be larger than one half, forgetting that size depends on both numbers.
annotations.connections: This connects to finding equivalent fractions by showing how different fractions can name the same exact value.
